simulation: The bundled agent ran on this Windows machine, with both "drives" as folders on one disk under the test-only allowance. The drive died by deleting the folder. Staging has no staff-token key, so no till can unlock on a box there: each sale was handed to the same sale queue the till bridge calls, from a small helper with no network, built from the same source. A local rehearsal of this same code, against a local copy of the platform with a shift token, drove the real till bridge over HTTP and got 409 JOURNAL_AWAITING_EPOCH during the hold. Sales are recorded cash on a ZZ TEST till; no money moved, no SMS was sent and no member is named. A real Pi with a real second drive stays a bench check.
